entities.summary: Lazar Solomonovich Polyakov was a Russian entrepreneur. He founded his first bank in 1872 and by the 1890s owned an influential financial group; he was informally named "Rothschild of Moscow". His business collapsed in the early 1900s and was completely disbanded by 1909.
